facts.statement: Dendrorhynchoides is classified as a genus of anurognathid pterosaur.
facts.quote: Dendrorhynchoides is a genus of anurognathid pterosaur.

facts.statement: The genus was originally named Dendrorhynchus in 1998 by Ji Shu'an and Ji Qiang but was renamed Dendrorhynchoides in 1999 because the original name was preoccupied by a protozoan named in 1920.
facts.quote: The genus was first named Dendrorhynchus in 1998 by Ji Shu'an and Ji Qiang, but that name proved to be preoccupied by a parasitic protozoan named in 1920 by David Keilin. It was therefore renamed in 1999.

facts.statement: The type species D. curvidentatus is likely from the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation in Liaoning Province, China.
facts.quote: It contains only the holotype species, D. curvidentatus, which was likely recovered from the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation of Jinzhou, Liaoning Province, China.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen GMV2128 was discovered around 1995 and obtained by scientists from illegal fossil dealers.
facts.quote: The genus is based on holotype GMV2128, a fossil originally discovered around 1995 and obtained by science from illegal fossil dealers who first prepared it.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen is dated to approximately 124.6 million years old.
facts.quote: This specimen is thought to be from the Jianshangou Bed of the Yixian Formation, dated to about 124.6 million years old.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen was altered by amateur collectors to include a piece of a dromaeosaurid tail before scientific study.
facts.quote: However, the specimen was obtained by amateur collectors and altered to contain a piece of a dromaeosaurid tail before being studied.

facts.statement: In 2012, researchers David Hone and Lü Junchang suggested the holotype might actually come from Middle Jurassic deposits rather than the Early Cretaceous.
facts.quote: In 2012, David Hone and Lü Junchang considered it more likely that the holotype of D. curvidentatus was actually found in Middle Jurassic deposits

facts.statement: In a 2020 paper, David Hone reversed his earlier opinion and considered the holotype to be from the Early Cretaceous.
facts.quote: However, Hone would later reverse his position in a 2020 paper, considering it more likely that the holotype was in fact Early Cretaceous

facts.statement: A juvenile specimen believed to be Dendrorhynchoides was recovered in 2010 from the Middle Jurassic Tiaojishan Formation.
facts.quote: In 2010, a juvenile anurognathid specimen, believed to be from Dendrorhynchoides, was recovered from the Middle Jurassic Tiaojishan Formation.

facts.statement: A juvenile specimen designated as D. mutoudengensis was moved from the Guilin Geological Museum to the Jinzhou Paleontological Museum.
facts.quote: The specimen was originally stored in the Guilin Geological Museum and designated GLGMV 0002; later it was moved to the Jinzhou Paleontological Museum and designated JZMP-04-07-3.

facts.statement: In 2020, David Hone elevated the species D. mutoudengensis to a new genus named Luopterus.
facts.quote: Hone's 2020 paper, however, recognized that D. mutoudengensis was as distinct from D. curvidentatus as other species of anurognathids were from each other, and elevated it to a new genus and combination Luopterus mutoudengensis

facts.statement: The humerus is robust and elongated, measuring 27 millimeters in length.
facts.quote: The humerus is robustly built but elongated with a length of 27 millimetres.

facts.statement: The first phalanx of the wing finger is 44.5 millimeters long, while the second is 35.6 millimeters long.
facts.quote: The first phalanx of the fourth, wing, finger has a length of 44.5, the second of 35.6 millimetres.

facts.statement: The first three fingers are well developed and bear short but sharp claws.
facts.quote: The first three fingers are well developed with the first having an elongated first phalanx. They bear short but sharp claws.

facts.statement: The fifth toe is elongated.
facts.quote: The fifth toe is elongated.

facts.statement: Researchers postulated that Dendrorhynchoides was a tree-dwelling insectivore.
facts.quote: The describers postulated a tree-dwelling lifestyle for Dendrorhynchoides as an insectivore.

facts.statement: Researchers assumed Dendrorhynchoides had forward-facing large eyes and dark coloration to ambush insects nocturnally like modern nightjars or bats.
facts.quote: Its large eyes that were forward facing and the small claws on its appendages had researchers assuming that the species would match closely to tree bark or dark night colors to blend in with its surroundings and ambush insects for nocturnal hunting

facts.statement: The original authors classified Dendrorhynchoides as a long-tailed rhamphorhynchid rather than an anurognathid due to its presumed long tail.
facts.quote: Because of the presumed long tail, the authors rejected a placement within the Anurognathidae and classified it instead as a long-tailed rhamphorhynchid

facts.statement: A 2021 phylogenetic analysis placed Dendrorhynchoides within the subfamily Anurognathinae.
facts.quote: In 2021, a phylogenetic analysis conducted by Xuefang Wei and colleagues recovered Dendrorhynchoides within the subfamily Anurognathinae

facts.statement: The fossil range of Dendrorhynchoides spans from the Middle Jurassic to the Early Cretaceous.
facts.quote: fossil_range: Jurásico Medio - Cretácico Inferior

facts.statement: Dendrorhynchoides fossils are found in the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation in Liaoning and the Middle Jurassic Tiaojishan Formation in Hebei, China.
facts.quote: Dendrorhynchoides es un género extinto de pterosaurio anurognátido del Cretácico Inferior (principios del Aptiense) de la formación Yixian, cerca de Beipiao, Chaoyang, Liaoning, en China, y de la Formación Tiaojishan del Jurásico Medio de Qinglong, al norte de la provincia de Hebei, China.

facts.statement: The holotype of the type species was found in the Jianshangou Bed of the Yixian Formation, dating to 124.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: El holotipo de la especie tipo fue hallado en el Lecho Jianshangou de la Formación Yixian, que data de hace 124.5 millones de años.

facts.statement: The genus Dendrorhynchoides is based on the holotype GMV2128, a fossil discovered around 1995 that was obtained by illegal fossil dealers who had already prepared it.
facts.quote: El género está basado en el holotipo GMV2128, un fósil originalmente descubierto alrededor de 1995 y obtenido para la ciencia de vendedores de fósiles ilegales, quienes ya lo habían preparado.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of an almost complete skeleton of a subadult individual that is flattened.
facts.quote: Consiste en un esqueleto casi completo de un individuo subadulto y está aplastado.

facts.statement: The cervical vertebrae are short and wide.
facts.quote: Las vértebras cervicales son cortas y anchas.

facts.statement: The preserved tail length is five centimeters, though part of this is attributed to a section likely added to increase the fossil's value.
facts.quote: La cola tiene una longitud preservada de cinco centímetros, pero parte de esto se explica por una sección que podría haber sido añadida para aumentar el valor de los fósiles.

facts.statement: The humerus is robust but elongated, measuring 27 millimeters in length.
facts.quote: El húmero es de constitución robusta pero alargado con una longitud de 27 milímetros.

facts.statement: The ulna is 35.5 millimeters long.
facts.quote: El cúbito es de 35.5 milímetros de largo.

facts.statement: The metacarpals are short, measuring seven millimeters for the first three and 9.3 millimeters for the fourth wing finger metacarpal.
facts.quote: Los metacarpos son cortos con siete milímetros de largo para los primeros tres y 9.3 milímetros para el metacarpo del cuarto dedo alar.

facts.statement: The first phalanx of the wing finger (fourth) is 44.5 millimeters long, while the second is 35.6 millimeters long.
facts.quote: La primera falange del dedo alar (el cuarto) tiene una longitud de 44.5, el segundo de 35.6 milímetros.

facts.statement: A short and slender pteroid bone, 5.9 millimeters long, points toward the elbow.
facts.quote: Un corto y delgado hueso pteroide, de 5.9 millimetres de largo, apuntando hacia el codo.

facts.statement: The wingspan is nearly forty centimeters, making Dendrorhynchoides one of the smallest known pterosaurs.
facts.quote: La envergadura es de cerca de cuarenta centímetros, haciendo a Dendrorhynchoides uno de los menores pterosaurios conocidos.

facts.statement: The tibia was 26.7 millimeters long and is nearly one-third longer than the femur.
facts.quote: La tibia tenía una longitud de 26.7 milímetros y es cerca de un tercio más larga que el fémur.

facts.statement: The foot is long, with metatarsals measuring 12.1 millimeters in length.
facts.quote: El pie es largo con metatarsos de 12.1 milímetros de largo.

facts.statement: It was not until 2000 that Dendrorhynchoides was identified as an anurognathid, and it was confirmed that the fossil had been retouched before its description.
facts.quote: No fue hasta 2000 que se lo identificó como un anurognátido, y fue confirmado que el fósil había sido retocado antes de su descripción.

facts.statement: A 2006 phylogenetic analysis by Lü Junchang identified Dendrorhynchoides as the sister taxon to the clade formed by the other two species of Asiaticognathidae.
facts.quote: Un análisis hecho por Lü Junchang en 2006 resolvió estas relaciones filogenéticas aún más, hallando a Dendrorhynchoides como el taxón hermano del clado formado por las otras dos especies de asiaticognátidos.

facts.statement: The describers hypothesized that Dendrorhynchoides had an arboreal lifestyle and was an insectivore.
facts.quote: Los descriptores postularon un estilo de vida arbóreo para Dendrorhynchoides, como un insectívoro.

facts.statement: In 2010, a second juvenile specimen, GLGMV 0002, was published, proving that an elongated tail was present, though not as long as the falsified tail of the holotype, measuring about 85% of the femur length.
facts.quote: En 2010 un segundo espécimen de un juvenil, GLGMV 0002, fue publicado, lo que probó que una cola alargada estaba presente después de todo, aunque no tan larga como la cola falsificada del holotipo: cerca del 85% de la longitud del fémur.

facts.statement: This specimen was eventually designated as the holotype for the species Dendrorhynchoides mutoudengensis.
facts.quote: Este espécimen fue eventualmente designado como el holotipo de la especie Dendrorhynchoides mutoudengensis.

facts.statement: Dendrorhynchoides lived from the Bathonian to the Aptian stages, between 168.2 and 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bathonian to Aptian (168.2 to 119.57 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group of Dendrorhynchoides is Anurognathidae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Anurognathidae

facts.statement: Dendrorhynchoides belongs to the family Anurognathidae.
facts.quote: Family: Anurognathidae

facts.statement: Dendrorhynchoides is classified in the class Reptilia.
facts.quote: Class: Reptilia

rejected.quote: Dendrorhynchoides had a wingspan of about forty centimetres, making it one of the smallest known pterosaurs.

rejected.quote: Eleven teeth have been preserved scattered throughout the matrix, that are recurved with a broader base and have a length of three millimetres.
